_meta.write_via: 04-creatures/creature (direct, per WRITE_RULES.md section 9 ownership table); memory-bible collects this file into the Bible view
_meta.scope: Registry of (a) non-human creatures/animals that appear on screen as real, silent (non-speaking) animals, and (b) — added by BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22) — CGI rendering-spec entries for two fantastical creatures with no human-performer alternative left standing (the Gryphon, the Mock Turtle) plus one pending_H2 proposal (the Duchess's baby's pig end-state). WRITE_RULES.md P-007 still governs OWNERSHIP, not render technique: every talking animal/card figure registers as CHAR-* in bible/characters/, not here; entries added under (b) use 'owner_refs' to point back at their CHAR-* owner and never duplicate personality/dialogue/voice. Full appearance/behaviour/rendering cards are in bible/creatures/creature.json. See creature.json _meta.zero_entries_considered_and_excluded for candidates deliberately left out (Dinah, farm animals, etc.) and creature.json _meta.amendments for the BIB-0027 change record.

creatures.name: The White Rabbit (waking-world, real animal)

first_appearance.quote: suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her

creatures.reason: Same underlying source figure as CHAR-white-rabbit's dictionary term (TERM-0026), but this entry is scoped strictly to the mute, unclothed real rabbit seen only in the waking-world bracket of ch001, before the dream begins; see creature.json CRE-001.distinct_from.

creatures.name: The Puppy

first_appearance.quote: An enormous puppy was looking down at her with large round eyes

creatures.reason: Never speaks or reasons in the source (unlike the surrounding dream-figures), so it stays a real animal rather than a CHAR-* human performer; breed/coat/size are designed for image-generation precision, see creature.json CRE-002.

creatures.name: The Flamingo
creatures.reason: Explicitly 'live' and mute in the source (a croquet mallet, not a speaking dream-figure); per SUP-011 never shown being struck. See creature.json CRE-003.

creatures.name: The Hedgehog
creatures.reason: Explicitly 'live' and mute in the source (a croquet ball, not a speaking dream-figure); per SUP-011 never shown being struck. See creature.json CRE-004.

creatures.name: The Gryphon

first_appearance.quote: They very soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun.

creatures.reason: New (BIB-0027, user ruling 2026-09-22): a speaking, fantastical dream-figure with no real-world referent, now rendered as a photoreal CGI creature (SUP-010 amended). Registered here only as a CGI rendering-spec entry, owner_refs back to CHAR-gryphon which retains full character ownership. See creature.json CRE-005.
